title: Complete Risk-Prioritized Public API Documentation
purpose: Eliminate measured documentation debt across all AIAS Python packages and prevent future drift.
scope: Modules, public functions, public classes, public methods, risk prioritization, semantic alignment, regression validation and executable coverage gate.

requirements.title: Complete API scope
requirements.statement: The audit shall include modules, public functions, classes and methods.
requirements.rationale: Prevent false coverage claims that omit methods.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Risk prioritization
requirements.statement: Documentation shall be completed in deterministic risk-first order.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Zero measured debt
requirements.statement: Every current AIAS module and public symbol shall contain semantic documentation.
requirements.rationale: Close the recovered documentation decision fully.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Drift prevention
requirements.statement: Repository validation shall fail when a new undocumented public API appears.
requirements.rationale: Keep documentation complete as AIAS grows.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Behavior preservation
requirements.statement: Affected packages shall pass their functional regression suites.
requirements.rationale: Ensure documentation changes do not alter engineering behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The alignment shall include documentation, tests, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
